data.action: 站在浅水中，湿发贴着背
data.camera: side view, medium shot, horizontal framing
data.description: 夜色下波光粼粼的幽静浅海中，赤裸伫立在清凉海水中的斯卡蒂回眸凝视着你，湿漉漉的银发紧贴着光洁无瑕的后背与饱满挺翘的臀线。她向你伸出雪白的手臂——「海水的温度正好……敢脱掉衣服，和我一起沉入这片安静的海底吗？」
data.promptProse: Skadi looks back from the shallows, extending one hand toward the viewer; wet silver hair lies against her back above moonlit water.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 月光海浴
data.animaCaption: Her hand reaches toward the viewer above the shallow water.
